School of Computer and Data Sciences
Human Values.
Intelligent Systems.
Real-World Impact.
Technology is shaping how we learn, build, and connect. At the School of Computer and Data Sciences (SCDS), you’ll learn how to build the future—harnessing data, computing, and AI to solve problems, advance discovery, and improve lives.

Experience That Matters
Learning happens everywhere. From internships and student leadership opportunities to capstones and operations centers, as a student in SCDS you’ll have opportunity to apply your knowledge to real-world settings. Get experience, build confidence, and prepare for what’s next.

Latest News
Beth Plale joins CAS faculty experts to weigh in on midterm election issues
October 29, 2026
SCHOOL OF COMPUTER AND DATA SCIENCES - Executive Director Beth Plale joins College of Arts and Sciences faculty to weigh in on the hottest topics of this year's midterm election, including artificial intelligence, data centers, and more.
Computer science grads land dual opportunities at Meta
October 22, 2026
DATA SCIENCE - Opportunities to work at companies like the social media monolith Meta are significant accomplishments for one person, so it’s even more remarkable that Aliza Lisan and Hammad Ather both landed roles at the company at the conclusion of their graduate studies in the College of Arts and Sciences School of Computer and Data Sciences.
Data science students partner with Lane County to tackle inequality
October 15, 2026
DATA SCIENCE — Tasked with helping low-income residents find better employment, the Lane County Workforce Partnership turned to a team of four students at the University of Oregon who were motivated to use their skills and knowledge to impact the community.
School of Computer and Data Sciences positioned to shape future of AI use in academia
October 13, 2026
SCHOOL OF COMPUTER AND DATA SCIENCES — The School of Computer and Data Sciences has a seat at the table in the Alliance for Data Science and AI. Executive Director Beth Plale will serve a three-year term on the board of the Alliance for Data Science and AI, representing the University of Oregon alongside eight other academic institutions across the country.
Computer science alum uses leadership experience to land dream job
October 8, 2026
COMPUTER SCIENCE — When Noah Weis arrived at the University of Oregon as a first-year computer science major, he wasn’t sure what the future would hold. Fast forward four years: he took a job at a dream company because of the opportunities made available to him through the College of Arts and Sciences School of Computer and Data Sciences.
Training program brings cybersecurity to Oregon high schools
September 17, 2026
COMPUTER SCIENCE, CYBERSECURITY — The Department of Computer Science in the School of Computer and Data Sciences is working to grow the pool of students interested in cybersecurity before they even get to college. It starts with high school teachers and the Cybersecurity Teacher Training Workshop, “Training the Trainers.”

School of Computer and Data Sciences
Our mission is to empower a diverse population of students and faculty working to advance knowledge in computer and data science, train the next generation of scholars, and engage with the wider world to tackle interdisciplinary challenges.
To do this, we start by applying our knowledge and experience at home across the University of Oregon campus.
